name: Monika
source:
Monika is the president of the high school Literature Club. She welcomes Mario and the gang into the club and invites them to write poetry together.
[spoiler]She knows she's in a parody crossover mod but enjoys it enough to go along with it.

She is taken out and fused into King Koopa, who then impersonates her after the first day.[/spoiler]
